answers.core: AnimatedSprite and AnimatedSprite3D are core classes.
answers.workaround:
Yes. One simple, scalable way to do it requires appending this Script to a given AnimatedSprite:
```GDScript
# Godot 3.x
extends AnimatedSprite

func set_animation(_anim: String):
    var previous_animation = animation
    var previous_frame = frame
    super(_anim)
    if animation != previous_animation:
         if frame == previous_frame: # Means frame_changed hasn't been called by set_frame() already
              emit_signal("frame_changed")
```

title: Emit `AnimatedSprite.frame_changed` when switching animation, NOT just on `frame` index change
